title: Resolve Review Thread Result
description: Dry-run plan or apply result for the E13 reply-and-resolve write-side helper: post a reply to the thread that owns a review comment and resolve that thread in one invocation, or (body-item target) post one stamped top-level PR comment answering a review-body item that has no thread.

mode.description: Whether the helper planned or performed the reply-and-resolve operation.

prNumber.description: Pull request containing the review comment and thread.

commentId.description: Review comment identifier whose owning thread is located. Thread target only.

threadId.description: GraphQL node id of the resolved review thread; omitted when no thread owns the comment, and for a body item.

alreadyResolved.description: Whether the owning review thread was already resolved at inspection time, in either dry-run or apply mode. Thread target only.

reviewId.description: REST id of the review whose body lists the answered item. Body-item target only.

itemTitle.description: The answered Previously missed item's title, normalized to plain text. Body-item target only.

body.description: Reply body that will be posted (dry-run) or was posted (apply), including the injected reply-identity stamp. Omitted when --body is empty.

status.description: Outcome of the apply-mode reply-and-resolve attempt, or of the body-item post.

replyId.description: Identifier of the reply comment created before resolving the thread, or, for a body item, of the top-level PR comment posted.

error.description: Error reported when the reply, the thread resolution, or the body-item lookup or post could not be completed.
